summary_1line: While being abducted, Sita fiercely rebukes Ravana, condemning his cowardice and warning that Rama will destroy him for the crime.

image_candidates.scene_text: Ravana flies through the sky carrying the struggling Sita as she raises a tearful, furious face to denounce him.
Sita, hair streaming and tilaka smeared, points accusingly at Ravana while he bears her away through the air.
Below the sky-borne abduction, the forest and its trembling deities witness Sita crying out "O Rama, O Lakshmana."
